# world-layout v0.3
#
# This file is machine-written and machine-parsed. Humans DO NOT edit this file.
# Humans provide natural-language inputs (NL lines). These lines are immutable.
#
# Agents extract two things from the cumulative NL inputs:
#   (1) PHENOMENA       — behaviors or patterns that unfold over time
#   (2) DIMENSIONALITIES — variables/properties that can change over time
#
# Only PHEN and DIM represent the agent’s current best interpretation of the
# world described by ALL NL lines so far. These interpretations MAY be revised.
# PHEN/DIM snapshots appear after each NL line to show the full world state
# after processing that NL; the most recent snapshot is the current state.
#
# IMPORTANT:
#   - NL is append-only, preserved exactly as written.
#   - After every NL line, append the full PHEN/DIM snapshot reflecting the
#     world state after incorporating that NL (including any changes it
#     triggered). Duplication is expected; clarity is prioritized over size.
#   - PHEN and DIM MAY be replaced, updated, or superseded as understanding improves.
#   - Agent must ensure PHEN/DIM always reflect the most accurate world model.
#
# Example:
#   NL "a ball is dropped"
#   -> agent may infer PHEN falling; DIM height, velocity, gravity_strength
#
#   NL "on planet earth"
#   -> agent must revise previous DIM gravity_strength=9.8 m/s^2
#      if it had assumed another value or left it unspecified.
#
# PHENOMENON (PHEN):
#   Something that happens or unfolds over time.
#   Examples: "ball falls", "trucks queue", "inventory oscillates"
#
# DIMENSIONALITY (DIM):
#   A variable whose value may change over time.
#   Examples: position, velocity, queue_length, gravitational_strength
#
# SYNTAX:
#   NL <verbatim user text>
#   PHEN <id> description="<text>"
#   DIM  <id> description="<text>"
#
# RULES:
#   - NL is append-only and preserved verbatim.
#   - Each PHEN/DIM snapshot collectively represents the world interpretation
#     after processing that NL; the latest snapshot is the current state.
#   - PHEN/DIM MUST be updated when new NL changes meaning or invalidates assumptions.
#   - Agents may modify or replace PHEN/DIM lines, but must not modify NL lines.
#   - PHEN/DIM lines should follow the NL that triggered their creation or change.
#   - PHEN/DIM ids must be lowercase snake_case.
#   - Descriptions must be quoted strings.
#
# End of header.
NL 11x11 maze
PHEN maze_navigation description="navigation through an 11x11 maze grid formed by walls and passages"
DIM maze_width description="number of columns in the maze grid (currently 11)"
DIM maze_height description="number of rows in the maze grid (currently 11)"
DIM wall_configuration description="arrangement of walls and passages across the 11x11 grid; unspecified layout"
NL there's a traverser in the maze
PHEN maze_navigation description="a traverser navigates through an 11x11 maze grid formed by walls and passages"
DIM maze_width description="number of columns in the maze grid (currently 11)"
DIM maze_height description="number of rows in the maze grid (currently 11)"
DIM wall_configuration description="arrangement of walls and passages across the 11x11 grid; unspecified layout"
DIM traverser_position description="current location of the traverser within the 11x11 grid; unspecified coordinates"
NL there can be multiple traversers
PHEN maze_navigation description="one or more traversers navigate through an 11x11 maze grid formed by walls and passages"
DIM maze_width description="number of columns in the maze grid (currently 11)"
DIM maze_height description="number of rows in the maze grid (currently 11)"
DIM wall_configuration description="arrangement of walls and passages across the 11x11 grid; unspecified layout"
DIM traverser_positions description="current locations of all traversers within the 11x11 grid; unspecified coordinates and count"
NL each traverser has his own algorithm
PHEN maze_navigation description="multiple traversers independently navigate an 11x11 maze grid using their own algorithms through walls and passages"
DIM maze_width description="number of columns in the maze grid (currently 11)"
DIM maze_height description="number of rows in the maze grid (currently 11)"
DIM wall_configuration description="arrangement of walls and passages across the 11x11 grid; unspecified layout"
DIM traverser_positions description="current locations of all traversers within the 11x11 grid; unspecified coordinates and count"
DIM traverser_algorithms description="per-traverser navigation algorithms guiding movement decisions; unspecified types"
NL traversers do not know the map ahead of time
PHEN maze_navigation description="multiple traversers independently explore an 11x11 maze without prior map knowledge, using their own algorithms to navigate walls and passages"
DIM maze_width description="number of columns in the maze grid (currently 11)"
DIM maze_height description="number of rows in the maze grid (currently 11)"
DIM wall_configuration description="arrangement of walls and passages across the 11x11 grid; unspecified layout"
DIM traverser_positions description="current locations of all traversers within the 11x11 grid; unspecified coordinates and count"
DIM traverser_algorithms description="per-traverser navigation algorithms guiding movement decisions; unspecified types"
DIM traverser_map_knowledge description="per-traverser discovered map information accumulated during exploration; initially unspecified/empty"
NL some traversers have a special ability, they can branch search, where they duplicate themselves and share a global memory of where they visited
PHEN maze_navigation description="multiple traversers independently explore an 11x11 maze without prior map knowledge; some traversers can branch by duplicating themselves and use shared global visited memory while following their own algorithms through walls and passages"
DIM maze_width description="number of columns in the maze grid (currently 11)"
DIM maze_height description="number of rows in the maze grid (currently 11)"
DIM wall_configuration description="arrangement of walls and passages across the 11x11 grid; unspecified layout"
DIM traverser_positions description="current locations of all traversers, including branched duplicates, within the 11x11 grid; unspecified coordinates and count"
DIM traverser_algorithms description="per-traverser navigation algorithms guiding movement decisions; includes algorithms that permit branching"
DIM traverser_map_knowledge description="per-traverser discovered map information accumulated during exploration; initially unspecified/empty"
DIM branching_capable_traversers description="subset of traversers that can duplicate themselves for branching search; unspecified identities and count"
DIM global_visited_memory description="shared record of maze locations visited by branching-capable traversers; initially empty/unspecified"
